test_cases.name: Default table output (backward compatible)
test_cases.expected: Prints Region + instance count + full-field table; unchanged from the pre-export behaviour

test_cases.name: Export Markdown with explicit output path
test_cases.expected: Prints the generated .md path; file has title, Chinese header row (实例 ID/名称/状态/引擎/版本/规格/私有 IP/可用区/区域/创建时间), separator, and one row per instance

test_cases.name: Output flag implies Markdown format
test_cases.expected: Markdown file written; --status applied client-side (full list fetched, then filtered)

test_cases.name: Empty result still writes a Markdown file
test_cases.expected: Header + separator + '无 RDS 实例' note written, exit 0, no error

test_cases.name: Argument help (syntax)
test_cases.expected: argparse help printed (region / json / names-only / status / format / output), exit 0

env_vars_required: HUAWEI_ACCESS_KEY / HUAWEI_SECRET_KEY（或 HW_ACCESS_KEY / HW_SECRET_KEY、hcloud 已配置 profile）
notes: 只读操作（RDS ListInstances），无资源创建/修改/删除风险；Markdown 仅在本机生成，绝不写回云端。CLI 主路径使用 hcloud RDS ListInstances（只读 GET /v3/{project_id}/instances）；SDK 回退使用 huaweicloudsdkrds v3。缺 hcloud 后端/凭据时用例按后端可用性降级或跳过，不产生伪失败；真实只读验证由 QA 带外执行。离线单测：python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v。
